headline: A major US investment bank files for bankruptcy after weekend rescue talks fail, and another large bank agrees an emergency sale
A rating agency cuts a eurozone government's debt to junk status amid fears it cannot repay its debts
A rating agency strips the United States of its top credit rating after a bitter political fight over the debt limit
Fears grow that a heavily indebted Chinese property developer will default, raising worries about China's property sector
A major algorithmic stablecoin loses its dollar peg and its sister crypto token plunges
Swiss authorities force a troubled global bank into an emergency takeover by its larger rival, wiping out some of its bonds
A large European bank freezes investment funds exposed to US subprime mortgages, saying it cannot value them, and the central bank injects emergency cash into money markets
Major central banks jointly make dollar loans cheaper for banks to ease funding stress from the European debt crisis
Overnight funding rates in the US repo market spike sharply, forcing the Federal Reserve to inject cash for the first time in a decade
The UK government announces large unfunded tax cuts in a mini-budget
A large US bank serving tech start-ups collapses after a run on deposits triggered by losses on its bond holdings
Japanese stocks crash as a Bank of Japan rate hike and weak US jobs data force investors to unwind yen-funded trades
A major hurricane makes landfall on the US Gulf Coast, shutting most offshore oil production and many refineries
A massive earthquake and tsunami hit Japan, and a nuclear power plant loses its cooling systems
Drone and missile attacks hit Saudi Arabia's main oil processing plant, knocking out about half of the kingdom's oil output
China locks down a major city and nearby cities, home to millions of people, to contain a new coronavirus outbreak
One of the largest crypto exchanges halts customer withdrawals after a run, raising fears it is insolvent
A faulty software update from a cybersecurity firm crashes millions of computers worldwide, grounding flights and disrupting banks and hospitals
OPEC decides not to cut oil production despite a global glut, choosing to defend market share against US shale producers
The United Kingdom votes to leave the European Union in a surprise referendum result
Coronavirus cases surge in Italy and South Korea, and fears grow of a global pandemic
Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and Western governments prepare sweeping sanctions
The Federal Reserve raises interest rates by three-quarters of a point, its biggest hike in decades, to fight high inflation
The US announces sweeping tariffs on almost all trading partners, far larger than markets expected
